# Active research sources

Pinned native repositories, licenses, used source paths, competitor limitations and optional Round 3 sources are listed in [SOURCES.md](SOURCES.md).

PyCIL supplies iCaRL/PODNet/WA/GEM; loss-of-plasticity supplies B5 and CBP. UPGD, C-Flat, warm_start and dopamine supply the competitor implementations. The algorithms and numerical references are in [docs/vna](../docs/vna).
